decision: M8-B production graph envelope (execution contract packet_inputs.M8-B)

envelope.canvas_scope: one episode per Canvas (DramaClaw donor precedent: FreezoneCanvasScope episode/beat/asset)

reference_environment.machine: recorded exactly (CPU, RAM, GPU, display refresh rate)
reference_environment.low_end_profile: 4x CPU throttling; must meet the discrete-operation threshold at the 100-node rung

envelope.repetitions: at least 30 per operation per rung, over 3 cold runs
envelope.on_failure: blocks the React Flow adapter, not the M8-A exploration authority (spec section 7)

note: M8-B Task B1 freezes the benchmark protocol file (R2_M8_B_CANVAS_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.json) from this envelope before any result exists.
